name: Data Grid
summary: A composable, sortable table built on TanStack Table with column header menus.
useWhen: Showing records people compare and sort
Columns have clear types such as dates or names
avoidWhen: Very large data sets, because it has no built-in virtualization
Narrow screens, unless you plan for horizontal scrolling
Sorting, filters, row selection and pagination, where data-display/data-table-06 fits better
